findings.title: Cleartext HTTP served without redirect to HTTPS
findings.expected: http:// requests receive 301/308 to the https:// equivalent | No application content or Set-Cookie on http://
actual: Plain HTTP serves content (HTTP 200) without HTTPS redirect
reproduction: navsentry test --config <manifest>  (rule NSC-CRYPT-006, transport direct-http)
Type http://<host>/ in the browser: it switches to https://
findings.recommendation: Redirect all HTTP to HTTPS at the edge; for internal service ports, enable TLS or restrict them to the internal network.
findings.regressionGuard: Machine clients that POST to http:// may not follow redirects with a body (use 308 to preserve method) — inventory them first.

findings.title: Insecure cache policy for sensitive responses
findings.expected: Responses served to authenticated actors or setting session cookies send `Cache-Control: no-store` (or `private, no-cache` where justified) | Static public assets may stay cacheable
reproduction: navsentry test --config <manifest>  (rule NSC-CONF-007, transport direct-http)
DevTools > Network: authenticated API responses show no-store
findings.recommendation: Add no-store on authenticated/sensitive routes (middleware by route group); keep long caching only for fingerprinted static assets.
findings.regressionGuard: Do not apply no-store to static assets (performance regression). Scope the header by route. Verify with `navsentry compare` and page-load timing.
